lead.fr: Séoul, puis la route jusqu'à Busan, la côte Est jusqu'à Sokcho, l'île de Jeju et les fleuves de l'Ouest : quatre mois à pédaler en famille, la remorque de Clémence derrière nous.
lead.en: Seoul, then the road to Busan, the east coast up to Sokcho, Jeju island and the rivers of the west: four months of family cycling, with Clémence's trailer behind us.

lead.fr: Un mois, 624 kilomètres et une remorque au sud du Japon : Fukuoka, Karatsu, Nagasaki, Amakusa, Kagoshima et Kumamoto.
lead.en: One month, 624 kilometres and a trailer across southern Japan: Fukuoka, Karatsu, Nagasaki, Amakusa, Kagoshima and Kumamoto.

lead.en: From Zagreb to the Mediterranean, through Slovenia, the Julian Alps and the Po plain, mixing cycling with Italian regional trains.

lead.fr: Six jours : en voiture jusqu'au lac de Neuchâtel et à Coire, puis en train par l'Albula et le Bernina jusqu'à Tirano, en Italie.
lead.en: Six days: by car to Lake Neuchâtel and Chur, then by train over the Albula and Bernina lines to Tirano, in Italy.

lead.en: A family week on bikes, from the Isère valley to the cliffs of the Vercors.

lead.en: From Gaillac to Lozère, along the Tarn gorges cycle route and its hilltop villages.

lead.en: There and back between Bédarieux and Castres on the old railway line of the Haut-Languedoc.

lead.en: Our first family cycling trip, along the canal to Agen and on to Bordeaux.

lead.en: From Langogne to Clermont-Ferrand along the Allier gorges: climbs, cool air, beautiful scenery and few tourists.

title.en: A weekend in Provence by bike

lead.en: The Easter weekend as a family from Avignon: Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, the Pont du Gard and the greenways.

title.fr: De Marseille à Lyon à vélo

lead.fr: Notre premier voyage à vélo, une dernière folie avant l'arrivée de bébé : la remontée de la vallée du Rhône, et toutes les erreurs de débutants possibles.
lead.en: Our first cycling trip, one last adventure before the baby arrived: up the Rhône valley, making every beginner's mistake in the book.

lead.en: Leaving home, Sydney, farm work, then thousands of kilometres of road from Queensland to the Northern Territory, on to Perth, Adelaide and Melbourne.

lead.en: Ubud, the rice terraces, sunrise on Mount Batur and a day of cycling between temples.

lead.en: From the volcanoes of the North Island to the fjords of Milford Sound, via Akaroa, Mount Cook and the Routeburn Track.

lead.fr: Quelques jours à Miami et en Floride, puis l'avion pour La Nouvelle-Orléans, les plantations de la River Road et le pays cajun.
lead.en: A few days in Miami and around Florida, then a flight to New Orleans, the River Road plantations and Cajun country.

lead.fr: Un premier chalet dans les Laurentides, Noël à New York en gardiens de chiens, l'Igloofest, une vraie tempête de neige, puis Niagara et Toronto.
lead.en: A first chalet weekend in the Laurentians, Christmas in New York as dog-sitters, Igloofest, a real snowstorm, then Niagara and Toronto.

lead.fr: La Highway 1, San Francisco, Las Vegas, Zion, Antelope Canyon et la Route 66.
lead.en: Highway 1, San Francisco, Las Vegas, Zion, Antelope Canyon and Route 66.

lead.fr: Hiroshima, Miyajima, Osaka et Nara.
lead.en: Hiroshima, Miyajima, Osaka and Nara.

lead.fr: Québec, l'île d'Orléans, le fjord du Saguenay, Tadoussac et les couleurs de l'automne, avant l'installation à Montréal.
lead.en: Québec City, Île d'Orléans, the Saguenay fjord, Tadoussac and the autumn colours, before settling in Montréal.

title.en: Canadian summer: Ontario and the Rockies

lead.fr: Ottawa, les plages de l'Ontario et l'île Manitoulin, puis Banff, le glacier Bow et l'Iceline Trail dans les Rocheuses.
lead.en: Ottawa, Ontario's beaches and Manitoulin Island, then Banff, Bow Glacier and the Iceline Trail in the Rockies.

lead.en: Six hours by boat from Palawan, a bout of food poisoning and unexpected encounters on the island of Coron.

lead.fr: Kotor, le mont Lovćen et les bouches de Kotor : nos plus belles images d'un pays fabuleusement beau.
lead.en: Kotor, Mount Lovćen and the Bay of Kotor: our favourite pictures of a fabulously beautiful country.
